title: Domain Knowledge V2.5
description: What is known of the domain of an application, as items of text: the knowledge base an application gives (a CAV: the places it can go to and what it can do; an Audio Scene: its instruments and operations), and the items of it that Domain Knowledge Retrieval (MMC-DKR) finds relevant to a request, each with its Relevance. An item may name something the application has: its Name, and the Reference by which the application identifies it.

DomainKnowledgeTime.description: Time this Domain Knowledge was produced.

Domain.description: What the knowledge is about, in a sentence: the application and its domain.

ItemID.description: Identifier of the item within this Domain Knowledge.

Name.description: The name of what the item is about, as a person says it (a place, an instrument).

Synonyms.description: Other words and phrases by which a person says the same as the Name: the vocabulary of the domain, with its synonyms and variations.

Reference.description: The identifier by which the application identifies what is named (a Way Point of an Offline Map, an Object of a Scene).

Source.description: Where the item comes from (a document, a Data Type of the application).

Relevance.description: How relevant the item is to the request it was retrieved for, given by Domain Knowledge Retrieval: 1 for an item the request names (its Name or one of its Synonyms), less than 1 for the others.
